topic.title: D. B. Cooper
topic.angle: the only unsolved US air piracy

script.title: The Hijacker Who Vanished Into the Night Sky

scenes.narration: A man jumped from a jet in the dark, in the rain, with $200,000. And he was never seen again.
scenes.image_prompt: a dark passenger jet silhouette flying through storm clouds at night, lightning in the distance, seen from below

scenes.narration: It was November 24, 1971. A man in a dark suit bought a one-way ticket to Seattle.
scenes.image_prompt: empty 1970s airport gate at night, rows of vinyl chairs, a single flickering light

scenes.narration: He gave his name as Dan Cooper, and told a flight attendant he had a bomb in his briefcase.
scenes.image_prompt: a lone dark briefcase on an airplane seat, harsh cabin light, close-up

scenes.narration: His demands were simple. $200,000 in cash, and four parachutes.
scenes.image_prompt: stacks of old banknotes bundled in a canvas bag on a metal table, dim light, overhead shot

scenes.narration: In Seattle, the passengers were released. The money and parachutes were delivered.
scenes.image_prompt: a jet parked on a wet night runway, floodlights and fog, wide shot

scenes.narration: Then the plane took off again, heading toward Mexico City.
scenes.image_prompt: airplane wing view at night above dark clouds, blinking red light

scenes.narration: Somewhere over southwest Washington, in darkness and rain, he opened the rear stairs and jumped.
scenes.image_prompt: dark forest canopy seen from high above at night, rain streaks, faint moonlight

scenes.narration: No parachute was ever found. No body. Nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: misty pine forest at dawn, empty, silent, a single beam of light through trees

scenes.narration: But in 1980, a boy digging by the Columbia River found $5,800 in rotting bundles.
scenes.image_prompt: river bank sand with decayed bundles of old cash half buried, cold morning light, macro

scenes.narration: The serial numbers matched the ransom. The rest has never turned up.
scenes.image_prompt: close-up of a worn banknote serial number under a magnifying glass, shadows

scenes.narration: The FBI closed its active investigation in 2016, after 45 years.
scenes.image_prompt: an old filing cabinet drawer in a dim archive room, folders, dust in the air

scenes.narration: So where did he land? Did he survive? What do you think?
scenes.image_prompt: a lone dark silhouette of a tree line under a huge pale moon, fog, empty field

script.description: On a rainy night in 1971, a hijacker demanded a fortune, jumped from a Boeing 727, and disappeared.
